description: Defines command classes for controlling and configuring a flexible O-DU (Open Distributed Unit) in a 5G radio system, including gain, CFO, timing, log level, and metrics commands.

classes.name: tx_gain_app_command
classes.description: Command to set the transmission gain for a specified port.

classes.name: rx_gain_app_command
classes.description: Command to set the reception gain for a specified port.

classes.name: change_log_level_app_command
classes.description: Command to change the log level of a specific logging channel.

classes.name: cfo_app_command
classes.description: Command to set the Carrier Frequency Offset (CFO) for a sector.

classes.name: tx_time_offset_app_command
classes.description: Command to set the transmit time offset for a sector.

classes.name: ru_metrics_subcommand_stdout
classes.description: Subcommand to print RU metrics to stdout.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command with provided arguments, performing validation and calling appropriate controller methods.
